stem.text: A stationary wave is formed on a stretched string. The diagram illustrates the string at an instant of time when the displacement of the string is at its maximum.

stem.alt: Diagram of a stationary wave on a string between two fixed points, drawn as a single curve above a dashed horizontal line. Labels: fixed point (both ends), string, and P.

stem.text: The frequency of the wave is $250\,\text{Hz}$. Point P on the string has a vertical displacement of $-1.0\,\text{mm}$.
What will be the vertical displacement of the point P after a time of $5.0\,\text{ms}$?
